slice: E1: immediate and offset facts, assembler round trips
observed: Immediate constraints are repeated in immediate.rs, lower.rs, validate.rs and emit.rs. BinaryImm validation only checks logical masks: forged unshifted add/sub immediates and invalid shift counts are not rejected. Normal lowering already constrains them. This is the recorded Appendix A gap, not a new operation.

scope.included: Canonical encodings.v1 data and generated Rust for unshifted add/sub/compare imm12, shifted-add chunk size, signed imm9 and scaled imm12 memory offsets, signed imm7 pair offsets, mov-wide 16-bit fields/shift units, logical-mask element widths, scalar shift limits and the TBZ/ADR reach used by existing conservative relaxation thresholds. Reuse existing register-width facts. Migrate existing consumers without selecting more encodings.
scope.policy_unchanged: Preserve movz/movk order and zero behavior, C1/C2 tie ordering, memory folding block scan and byte-expansion guard, conservative 4-byte-scaled frame limit, 8-byte paired-save stride, and the exact relaxation margins. Encoding maxima are distinct from selection/frame policy.
scope.validator: Reject malformed BinaryImm forms against their existing EvoMIR contract: add/sub unshifted imm12, logical encodings, in-range shifts, general operands, and no immediate multiply/divide. Do not broaden validation for memory expansion forms or change interpreter semantics.
scope.excluded: Instruction selection changes, new forms/options/defaults, allocation/frame changes, a new DSL or handwritten ISA semantics, P0/g0/R03, latency, new audit layers. Vendor semantic execution and bounded SMT are separately frozen N07 E2/E3 work, not E1 acceptance.

source.origin: Automatically translated Arm 2023-03 ASL. Existing immediate/address decode fields checked read-only before this plan; no vendor model execution or correctness proof claimed.

sequence: Commit this work plan and fresh A/B baseline measurement plans before running. Existing T2 objects were retired; retain fresh baseline objects until after full-byte comparisons.
Record default-OFF Darwin and Linux 384-case object corpora and both six-TU arms on this unchanged implementation. Freeze after-plans binding the completed baseline receipts before implementation.
Commit REDs for the observed validator gap and missing generated encoding facts. Implement the migration, keeping all ordinary output byte-identical.

Run focused boundary/assembler tests, full workspace gate, both native corpora and six-TU after captures with existing byte comparator. Close with one-page note/receipt, retire only measured temporary objects and report disk delta.
red: Rebound malformed/duplicate/missing encoding rows; checked-in regeneration and original fact owners consuming generated data.
All unshifted imm12 boundaries, signed/scaled offset boundaries/alignment, pair boundaries, wide halves/shifts and scalar shift boundaries, including wrong-width high bits.

Independent enumeration of all 1,302 W and 5,334 X logical masks and random nonencodings; assemble generated valid instances on both OS targets and disassemble/reassemble text bytes using the platform tools.
Malformed add/sub 4096/4097/MAX, shifts equal to register width, and immediate mul/div must be rejected by public MIR validation; existing valid public lowering continues to pass.
Assembler accept/reject at TBZ/ADR reach boundaries; conservative selection thresholds remain exactly unchanged.

acceptance.objects: Six S5 TUs, A/B, checked/unchecked: two identical builds each, full-byte equality with fresh pre-migration objects. Existing Darwin/Linux corpus: 384 cases each, two identical objects each and equality with pre-migration capture.
acceptance.native: Existing corpus execution, selected-TU harnesses, per-instance allocation validation and no-option lowering results stay unchanged. Focused ON-path boundary tests cover C1 constants/C2 local forms/frame-pair consumers without changing their admission dispositions.
acceptance.stop: Any object difference is a migration failure, not an improvement. Preserve the failing case and fix or separate it. No model/SMT or whole-backend proof claim.

resources.retention: Keep compact logs, hashes, measurements and reproducers. No full disassembly retained. Baseline and candidate objects retired only after byte comparison and idle-handle checks; protected evidence and Lean cache untouched.

claim_ceiling: Encoding legality and text round-trip oracle for existing admitted forms; not semantic ISA/model validation, SMT proof, new size benefit, default optimization admission or complete N07.
